# Favicon pack — EchoVerse | Hydrilla Gorilla

This folder contains the site favicons and app icons.

## Files (generated by build script)

| File | Size | Use |
|------|------|-----|
| `favicon.ico` | 16×16, 32×32 | Browser tab, bookmarks |
| `favicon-16x16.png` | 16×16 | Browser tab (modern) |
| `favicon-32x32.png` | 32×32 | Browser tab, bookmarks |
| `apple-touch-icon.png` | 180×180 | iOS home screen |
| `android-chrome-192x192.png` | 192×192 | Android / PWA |
| `android-chrome-512x512.png` | 512×512 | Android splash / PWA |
| `site.webmanifest` | — | PWA manifest (name, icons, theme) |

## Regenerating the pack

From the project root (`hg`):

```bash
python favicons/build_favicons.py
```

**Source image:** `images/hg-logo.png` (or drop `source.png` in the `favicons/` folder to use that instead).

Requires Python 3 and Pillow: `pip install Pillow`
